reason: Verified in code: tools/runtime_ledger.py exp_token() takes the FIRST exp<N> token (EXP_TOKEN l.73), family_of() maps it via EXP_RULES (l.65-71), and pick_k2() auto-selects K2 only when that token == 'exp58'. Tested: a message like 'probe 37: K2 = x138 (exp56) + ... exp58' -> exp56 -> family x138 (7.5 h deadline, no insertion gate) and K2 would never be picked (A5-L(K2) stuck at WATCH). The proposed message 'probe 37: exp58 = K2 (x138 + safetail C01 + lowrefine + DaughterNet insertion #35 config); dummy gates 18/18' -> exp58 -> safetail (9.5 h, insertion gate 8.0 h), which matches the K2 build (REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200, DIVINS_DEADLINE_S=28800; CONTEXT l.1773); '#35'/'C01' do not match the regex. This matters: the step-0 K2 forecast (<= ~7.8 h) lies between 7.5 and 9.5 h, so a mis-class would turn R5(a) into NO/UNPROVEN and could raise the A6 K1-swap contingency wrongly, i.e. affect finals admission. Daily cap: 5 submissions already dated 25 Sep (ledger.md 20:22Z), so the 00:01 UTC slot is correct. Pure process fix, no score value, byte-identical kernel (only the -m text), fits R1-R10 and the pre-approved K2 slot.
fix: Submit K2 (vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp58-x138-safe-lowref, -v 1, the dummy-gated version) after 00:00:30 UTC 26 Sep with -m starting 'probe 37: exp58 = K2 (...)' and no other exp<N> token before exp58. Then run python tools/runtime_ledger.py --k2 <ref> --family <ref>=safetail (the ref override beats any token) and check ledger.md shows family 'safetail (9.5 h)' and A5-L(K2) WATCH naming that ref; keep --k2/--family in the poller's ledger call until K2 scores.
realistic_gain: 0 on LB/private (process only). Prevents a wrong R5(a)/A5/A6 reading for the main finals candidate K2, whose latency (~7.8 h forecast) sits between the 7.5 h and 9.5 h deadlines.
